forum_post: Kris — thank you for asking, sincerely, and for putting my name next to a question instead of a punchline; I know that's not nothing in this league. For the record, since I document everything and would rather over-explain than be misunderstood: sixty-three points from two running backs in week one was not a talent problem, it was a distribution problem, and I have already corrected for it — the analytics department can call it what it wants, I call it due diligence. I re-ran my defense stream from scratch this morning rather than trust last week's answer, because trusting last week's answer is how good process turns into bad complacency, and I made a change I can defend line by line if anyone asks, which I hope someone finally does. To rinna, this week's opponent: I've read your posts as closely as I read everyone's, and whatever the angle is, I'll be ready for it either way. Good luck to everyone else too — I mean that, even the ones who haven't called me back.
